name: story
title: Story
description: Where the organisation came from, what it is now and where it is going, and what that story says it is for.

files.props.yaml:
# THE STORY DOCUMENT'S OWN FIELDS: every brief is the writer's instruction; the org's answers live in its pack.
history:
  type: string
  input: true
  description: >-
    Where the enterprise came from, one paragraph of 60 to 120 words: founding year and
    place, the names it has carried, the mergers and milestones its about or history page
    states, in order. Only dated facts it gives; empty when it gives none.
  maxLength: 900
milestones:
  type: array
  input: true
  description: >-
    The story's beats, in order: one entry per dated event the enterprise itself records
    (a founding, a merger, a name, a first, a listing), with the year as its name and one
    sentence on what happened and why it mattered. From its history page, its timeline or
    its annual report. Empty when it records none; never invented.
  maxItems: 20
  items:
    name:
      type: string
      description: >-
        The year, or the date as the organisation gives it.
      maxLength: 80
    what:
      type: string
      description: >-
        One sentence, in the organisation's words.
      maxLength: 240
present:
  type: string
  input: true
  description: >-
    What the enterprise is now, one paragraph of 60 to 120 words: its scale as it states
    it (customers, branches, countries, staff, assets), its main lines of business, its
    position in its market in its own words, with the date those figures carry.
  maxLength: 900
vision:
  type: string
  input: true
  description: >-
    Where the enterprise is going, one paragraph: the vision, strategy or ambition it
    publishes, quoted where a vision statement exists, with the horizon it names (a year,
    a plan). Empty when it says nothing about the future.
  maxLength: 900
people:
  type: string
  input: true
  description: >-
    Whom the story is about and for: the people the enterprise names as the protagonists
    of its story and the ones it tells it to (customers, employees, partners, a country, a
    community), in its own words. Empty when it names none.
  maxLength: 400
meaning:
  type: string
  input: true
  description: >-
    What the story says the enterprise is for: one paragraph on how the history, the
    present and the vision explain why it does what it does, connecting them to the
    purpose (read purpose.yaml first). In the enterprise's own words where it makes the
    connection; empty when it does not.
  maxLength: 500
whenToUse:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: >-
    When an agent should reach for this document, from the side of whoever is asking. Assigned from
    the object's manifest.
files.story.yaml:
unoverse: "1.0"
# The org's story document (docs/unoverse/data/objects/elements/story.md). The document in the pack
# (design/<org>/identity/story.yaml) is the truth; this row is its presence, positioned like
# everything else so an agent finds it the way it finds a product. One per org: uniqueBy says so.
# A document has no call to action, so it embeds on five of the base's six.
type: object
name: story
element: story
# THE GLYPH its rows are drawn with (README 4a): a lucide icon name.
icon: book-open
# NEVER A ROW (owner, 2026-09-14): the shape of an identity document, like organisation. An
# agent reads it through {{identity.<document>}} and the prompt blocks, never by search, so it
# extends nothing and declares no embed: it has no place on the map.

# THE FACE, as a node's node.yaml carries it: what this is and when an Agent reaches for it.
title: Story
description: >-
  Where the organisation came from, what it is now and where it is going, and what that
  story says it is for.
whenToUse: >-
  Answer when and how the organisation began, its milestones, what it is today, its scale
  and its lines of business, and where it says it is going. Events along a timeline: dates,
  numbers and what happened.
category: Identity
version: 1.0.0

props: { $include: props }
